name: workspace-list

description: Loads an additional writable workspace. Open only a fully trusted workspace: loading evaluates MSBuild project logic, evaluated source inputs including external linked or package-provided documents become queryable, and later diagnostic or Code Action operations can load and execute project analyzers with the Host's permissions. Documents outside workspaceRoot remain read-only. If instance status reports that the workspace is or may be in use elsewhere, use it only for necessary queries, expect results to become stale, and coordinate mutation ownership before starting a transaction.

alias.description: The optional caller-friendly alias for the workspace.

msBuildProperties.description: The optional allowlisted MSBuild global properties used to evaluate this workspace.

artifactsPath.description: Existing absolute directory used for MSBuild intermediate and output artifacts.

configuration.description: MSBuild Configuration global property, such as Debug or Release.

platform.description: MSBuild Platform global property, such as AnyCPU or x64.

runtimeIdentifier.description: MSBuild RuntimeIdentifier global property used to evaluate the workspace.

targetFramework.description: MSBuild TargetFramework global property used to select a target-specific project evaluation.

path.description: The absolute solution or project path to load.

workspaceRoot.description: The optional absolute repository or workspace root used for coordination and transaction boundaries.
